_note: The quartermaster picks the first rule whose 'when' fits the quest, else 'default'. Keep 'why' so future you knows the reason. Copy to ~/.guild/local/dispatch.json and edit there.

_harnesses.claude: Claude Code on your Anthropic plan. Model: opus, sonnet, haiku, or a full id like claude-fable-5-1.
_harnesses.openrouter: Claude Code pointed at OpenRouter, so any model it serves can run a quest. Model: an OpenRouter id, like moonshotai/kimi-k2-thinking, deepseek/deepseek-chat, or ~anthropic/claude-sonnet-latest. Needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY in ~/.guild/local/env.
_harnesses.codex: OpenAI Codex CLI, on your ChatGPT or API account. Model: gpt-5.6-codex and friends. Runs sandboxed to the worktree.

rules.when: New feature or UI work where quality of design matters
rules.why: Best at product and UI judgment; worth the quota for new features

rules.when: Hard planning, architecture, or an ambiguous investigation
rules.why: Deep reasoning for work where the path is not clear yet

rules.when: The task needs generating or editing images
rules.why: Codex has native image generation; Claude does not

rules.when: Long, mechanical work: renames, migrations, test scaffolding, large sweeps
rules.why: Keeps the Anthropic quota for work that needs judgment

rules.when: Simple bug fix whose root cause and expected behavior are already known
rules.why: Well defined work does not need the biggest model
